---
engine: knitr
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: false
    output-file: Barbone-CV.pdf
    papersize: us-letter
    margin: 
      x: "0.5in"
      y: "0.5in"
    footer: true
    numbering: true
    template-partials:
      - cv/typst-template.typ
execute:
  echo: false
params:
  metadata_file: _metadata.yaml
  csl_file: csl/apa-cv.csl
  bib_publications: bib/publications.bib
  bib_thesis: bib/thesis.bib
  bib_posters_cogstate: bib/posters_cogstate.bib
  bib_posters_cog: bib/posters_cog.bib
  bib_posters_madrigal: bib/posters_madrigal.bib
  bib_posters_signant: bib/posters_signant.bib
  bib_posters_wcupa: bib/posters_wcupa.bib
  bib_packages: bib/packages.bib
---

```{r}
#| labels: functions
typst_string <- function(x) {
  jsonlite::toJSON(as.character(x %||% ""), auto_unbox = TRUE)
}

linkify_urls <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x %||% "")

  # DOI URLs -> concise DOI labels
  x <- gsub(
    "(?<!\\()\\bhttps?://(?:dx\\.)?doi\\.org/(?:doi/)?([A-Za-z0-9._;()/:+-]+)",
    "[doi:\\1](https://doi.org/\\1)",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  # Other bare URLs -> standard markdown links
  gsub(
    "(?<!\\()\\b(https?://[A-Za-z0-9./?=&_%#:+~-]*[A-Za-z0-9/_#])",
    "[\\1](\\1)",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
}

pandoc_md_to_typst <- function(x) {
  x <- linkify_urls(as.character(x %||% ""))
  in_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".md")
  out_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".typ")

  writeLines(x, in_file)
  rmarkdown::pandoc_convert(
    input = in_file,
    to = "typst",
    output = out_file,
    options = c("--wrap=none")
  )

  paste(readLines(out_file, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}

bullet_items <- function(text) {
  if (is.null(text)) {
    return(character())
  }

  lines <- strsplit(as.character(text), "\\n", fixed = FALSE)[[1]]
  lines <- trimws(lines)
  lines[nzchar(lines)]
}

to_typst_content <- function(x) {
  paste0("[", pandoc_md_to_typst(x), "]")
}

emit_group_items <- function(title, items) {
  items <- as.character(items)
  items <- items[nzchar(trimws(items))]

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    title: ", to_typst_content(title), ","),
    "    body: ["
  )

  for (it in items) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("      - ", pandoc_md_to_typst(it)))
  }

  c(out, "    ],", "  ),")
}

emit_named_groups <- function(groups) {
  out <- c("(")

  for (g in groups) {
    out <- c(out, emit_group_items(g$title, g$items))
  }

  out <- c(out, ")")
  paste(out, collapse = "\n")
}

experience_group_item <- function(company, items) {
  # list is newest-first; use first non-empty location as most recent location
  locations <- vapply(
    items,
    \(x) as.character(x$location %||% ""),
    NA_character_
  )
  nz <- which(nzchar(trimws(locations)))
  recent_location <- if (length(nz) > 0) locations[nz[1]] else ""

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    org: ", to_typst_content(company), ","),
    paste0("    location: ", to_typst_content(recent_location), ","),
    "    roles: ("
  )

  for (item in items) {
    bullets <- bullet_items(item$accomplishments)

    out <- c(
      out,
      "      (",
      paste0("        role: ", to_typst_content(item$position), ","),
      paste0("        dates: ", to_typst_content(item$period), ","),
      "        bullets: ("
    )

    for (b in bullets) {
      out <- c(out, paste0("          ", to_typst_content(b), ","))
    }

    out <- c(out, "        ),", "      ),")
  }

  c(out, "    ),", "  ),")
}

education_item <- function(item) {
  bullets <- bullet_items(item$details)

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    org: ", to_typst_content(item$institution), ","),
    paste0("    credential: ", to_typst_content(item$degree), ","),
    paste0("    location: ", to_typst_content(item$location), ","),
    paste0("    dates: ", to_typst_content(item$period), ","),
    "    bullets: ("
  )

  for (b in bullets) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("      ", to_typst_content(b), ","))
  }

  c(out, "    ),", "  ),")
}

skills_item <- function(item) {
  c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    name: ", to_typst_content(item$name), ","),
    paste0("    details: ", to_typst_content(item$details), ","),
    "  ),"
  )
}

format_refs_apa <- function(bib_files, csl_file = params$csl_file) {
  bib_files <- normalizePath(bib_files, mustWork = TRUE)
  csl_file <- normalizePath(csl_file, mustWork = TRUE)

  in_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".md")
  out_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")

  yaml_block <- c(
    "---",
    paste0("csl: ", csl_file),
    "bibliography:",
    paste0("  - ", bib_files),
    "nocite: '@*'",
    "---",
    "",
    "::: {#refs}",
    ":::"
  )

  writeLines(yaml_block, in_file)

  rmarkdown::pandoc_convert(
    input = in_file,
    to = "html",
    output = out_file,
    options = c("--citeproc", "--wrap=none")
  )

  html <- xml2::read_html(out_file)
  nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(
    html,
    "//div[@id='refs']/*[contains(@class, 'csl-entry')]"
  )

  refs <- trimws(xml2::xml_text(nodes))
  bold_me(refs[nzchar(refs)])
}


bold_me <- function(x) {
  gsub("Barbone, J. M.", "**Barbone, J. M.**", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data
meta <- yaml::read_yaml(params$metadata_file)
experience <- meta$experience
education <- meta$education
skills <- meta$skills
courses <- meta$courses
extracurriculars <- meta$extracurriculars
awards <- meta$awards
tutoring_subjects <- meta$tutoring

parse_month_year <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x %||% ""))
  if (!nzchar(x)) {
    return(as.Date("1900-01-01"))
  }

  x_low <- tolower(x)
  if (x_low %in% c("present", "current")) {
    return(as.Date("9999-12-31"))
  }

  parts <- strsplit(x, "\\s+")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) < 2) {
    return(as.Date("1900-01-01"))
  }

  month_num <- match(parts[1], month.abb)
  year_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[2]))

  if (is.na(month_num) || is.na(year_num)) {
    return(as.Date("1900-01-01"))
  }

  as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year_num, month_num))
}

extract_end_date <- function(when) {
  bounds <- strsplit(as.character(when %||% ""), "\\s*-\\s*")[[1]]
  end_part <- if (length(bounds) >= 2) bounds[2] else bounds[1]
  parse_month_year(end_part)
}

extract_start_date <- function(when) {
  bounds <- strsplit(as.character(when %||% ""), "\\s*-\\s*")[[1]]
  start_part <- bounds[1]
  parse_month_year(start_part)
}

if (length(experience) > 0) {
  end_dates <- vapply(experience, \(x) extract_end_date(x$period), as.Date("1970-01-01"))
  start_dates <- vapply(experience, \(x) extract_start_date(x$period), as.Date("1970-01-01"))
  experience <- experience[order(end_dates, start_dates, decreasing = TRUE)]
}

paper_publications_bib <- params$bib_publications
paper_thesis_bib <- params$bib_thesis

poster_cogstate_bib <- params$bib_posters_cogstate
poster_cog_bib <- params$bib_posters_cog
poster_madrigal_bib <- params$bib_posters_madrigal
poster_signant_bib <- params$bib_posters_signant
poster_wcupa_bib <- params$bib_posters_wcupa

package_bib_files <- params$bib_packages

papers_publications <- format_refs_apa(paper_publications_bib)
papers_thesis <- format_refs_apa(paper_thesis_bib)
posters_cogstate <- format_refs_apa(poster_cogstate_bib)
posters_cog <- format_refs_apa(poster_cog_bib)
posters_madrigal <- format_refs_apa(poster_madrigal_bib)
posters_signant <- format_refs_apa(poster_signant_bib)
posters_wcupa <- format_refs_apa(poster_wcupa_bib)
packages <- format_refs_apa(package_bib_files)
```

```{r}
#| label: prep output
out <- c(
  "// Auto-generated from YAML sources. Do not edit manually.",
  "#import \"cv/typst-template.typ\": *",
  "",
  paste0("#let cv_given = ", typst_string(meta$given)),
  paste0("#let cv_surname = ", typst_string(meta$surname)),
  paste0("#let cv_location = ", typst_string(meta$location)),
  paste0("#let cv_phone = ", typst_string(meta$phone)),
  paste0("#let cv_phone_display = ", typst_string(meta$phone_display %||% meta$phone)),
  paste0("#let cv_email = ", typst_string(meta$email)),
  paste0("#let cv_web = ", typst_string(meta$web)),
  paste0("#let cv_github = ", typst_string(meta$github)),
  paste0("#let cv_linkedin = ", typst_string(meta$linkedin)),
  paste0("#let cv_professional_title = ", typst_string(meta$professional_title)),
  paste0("#let cv_summary_short = ", typst_string(meta$summary_short)),
  "",
  "#let experience_data = ("
)

experience_by_company <- split(
  experience,
  vapply(experience, \(x) x$company %||% "", NA_character_)
)

for (company in names(experience_by_company)) {
  items <- experience_by_company[[company]]
  out <- c(out, experience_group_item(company, items))
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let tutoring_items = (")

for (t in tutoring_subjects) {
  out <- c(
    out,
    paste0(
      "  ",
      to_typst_content(
        paste0("**", t$with, "**, ", t$what, " (", t$when, ") — ", t$where)
      ),
      ","
    )
  )
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let education_data = (")

for (i in seq_along(education)) {
  item <- education[[i]]
  out <- c(out, education_item(item))
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let skills_data = (")
for (s in skills) {
  out <- c(out, skills_item(s))
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let courses_items = (")
for (course in courses) {
  out <- c(
    out,
    paste0(
      "  ",
      to_typst_content(
        paste0("[", course$course, "](", course$link, ") — ", course$entity)
      ),
      ","
    )
  )
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let extracurriculars_items = (")
for (x in extracurriculars) {
  out <- c(
    out,
    paste0(
      "  ",
      to_typst_content(
        paste0("**", x$with, "**, ", x$what, " (", x$when, ") — ", x$where)
      ),
      ","
    )
  )
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let awards_items = (")
for (a in awards) {
  out <- c(
    out,
    paste0(
      "  ",
      to_typst_content(paste0("**", a$award, "** (", a$date, ") — ", a$organization)),
      ","
    )
  )
}

out <- c(out, ")", "")

paper_groups <- list(
  list(title = "Peer Reviewed Publications", items = papers_publications),
  list(title = "Master's Thesis", items = papers_thesis)
)
out <- c(
  out,
  paste0("#let paper_groups_data = ", emit_named_groups(paper_groups)),
  ""
)

poster_groups <- list(
  list(title = "Cogstate - Digital cognition", items = posters_cogstate),
  list(title = "Cogstate - Cognitive outcomes", items = posters_cog),
  list(title = "Madrigal - Liver disease", items = posters_madrigal),
  list(
    title = "Signant Health (Bracket) - eCOA data quality",
    items = posters_signant
  ),
  list(title = "WCUPA - Asthma and music cognitive", items = posters_wcupa)
)
out <- c(
  out,
  paste0("#let poster_groups_data = ", emit_named_groups(poster_groups))
)

out <- c(out, "", "#let packages_items = (")
for (pkg in packages) {
  out <- c(out, paste0("  ", to_typst_content(pkg), ","))
}
out <- c(out, ")")

out <- c(
  out,
  "",
  "#render_compact_cv(",
```
